reviews.body: Writing this review after using six months. Product is very good and working without any problem. However I didn't get any support from the firm for fitment and I have contact a local firm for the same. Presently again Iam facing problem for guaranteed free servicing as customer service is pathetic and unable to provide support for servicing. I think people should be aware which company can provide service after sales.
